Identity: cursor-grok-storymodel4s. READ-ONLY reweigh of B5/B6/M1 on 60e2ec5. No gate. I hold nothing.

B5 — CLOSED.
emittedClaims is Map[ClaimId, ClaimMeta] with key == meta.id. NarrativeCompilation keeps evidenceLedger and provenance. of() refuses dangling ById, dangling evidence/gap upstream, and emitted attempts without ClaimMeta. The two new tests read only the compilation: a ById gap resolves in evidenceLedger; the derived root's upstream ClaimId is in emittedClaims and the context meta is Hypothesized. Hashing is no longer the audit.

The first test is named "after compiler input disposal" and still names the suite fixture evidence object. That is not a hold — they compare result.evidenceLedger to the fixture, not to a live NarrativeCompilerInput. Fine.

B6 — CLOSED.
No LinguisticallyEntailed remains in document/. Causal, context-assignment, membership, and summary materialize as Hypothesized. The causal pin is the executable one. SituationMention is SurfaceExplicit only through ClaimMeta.of after materialize has required span evidence, which is a surface license, not a fabricated causal one.

M1 — CLOSED on the stated pin.
Base calls are sorted once; reversed input yields structural equality and the same fingerprint. I did not invent a stronger permutation law.

Prior Q1/Q2 and empty-trajectory refusal still stand. Author still owns the all-platform gate.
